abstract: It is a great privilege to be here, even if it is virtually, to celebrate Jim's impact on the profession, and in international trade in particular. Most of us here will know Jim's work from his seminal papers on trade policy (Brander and Krugman 1983, Brander 1995), and especially his work with his wife Barbara Spencer (Brander and Spencer 1981, 1983, 1985). Regardless, one look at his vita shows that his impact has been across fields, from his work on the environment (Brander and Taylor 1998), a personal favourite, finance (Brander and Lewis 1986, 1988), industrial organization (Brander and Eaton 1984, Brander and Zhang 1990) and business (Perloff and Brander 2017). He has written with many people, including Paul Krugman, Barbara Spencer, Jonathan Eaton, Tracey Lewis and Scott Taylor. His work has over 24,000 citations according to Google Scholar.
abstract_zh: 非常荣幸能在此发言，即便是在线上，以庆祝吉姆对经济学界，特别是国际贸易领域的深远影响。在座的多数人想必都通过他关于贸易政策的开创性论文（Brander and Krugman 1983, Brander 1995）了解其工作，尤其是他与妻子芭芭拉·斯宾塞的合作成果（Brander and Spencer 1981, 1983, 1985）。无论如何，翻阅他的履历便知，其影响力跨越多个领域，从环境经济学（Brander and Taylor 1998，个人尤为偏爱之作）、金融学（Brander and Lewis 1986, 1988）、产业组织理论（Brander and Eaton 1984, Brander and Zhang 1990）到商业研究（Perloff and Brander 2017）。他曾与多人合作，包括保罗·克鲁格曼、芭芭拉·斯宾塞、乔纳森·伊顿、特蕾西·刘易斯及斯科特·泰勒。据谷歌学术统计，其著作被引用次数已超过24,000次。
title: Reflections on trade policy: Then and now
title_zh: 贸易政策反思：过去与现在

abstract: This paper examines systematic inequalities in the sorting of students to university degree programs with regards to first-in-family (FIF) to attend university and gender. Using linked administrative data on the population of Portuguese applicants, we document that FIF students consistently match to lower quality degrees across the entire achievement distribution, while only the highest achieving female students relatively undermatch. Then, leveraging Portugal’s deferred acceptance centralized admissions system, we establish that these enrollment gaps are due to differences in student application patterns. We show these gaps remain after accounting for measurement error in student quality, through alternate measures and a lagged instrument approach. The paper concludes by exploring which factors do account for the gaps, finding that initial location explains much of the FIF gap, and degree subject closes the gender gap.
title: Keeping it in the family: Student to degree match
title_zh: 家族传承：学生与学位的匹配

abstract: This paper study the effects of investment delay on the dynamics of economic growth. We consider the modified Mankiw–Romer-Weil model in the form of a two-dimensional dynamical system with a time delay both in the production and depreciation. To analyse the solutions of the model we use one of the special functions, the Lambert W function. The analytical and numerical methods are used to study the local stability of steady solution. We find that the MRW model with production and depreciation delays exhibit cyclic behaviour. The curves of stability change are determined with respect to model parameters.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了投资延迟对经济增长动态的影响。我们考虑修正的曼昆-罗默-韦尔模型，该模型以二维动力系统形式呈现，并在生产与折旧过程中均引入时间延迟。为分析模型解，我们运用了特殊函数之一——朗伯W函数。通过解析与数值方法，我们考察了稳态解的局部稳定性。研究发现，包含生产与折旧延迟的MRW模型展现出周期性行为。我们确定了稳定性变化曲线相对于模型参数的分布。
title: Mankiw–Romer–Weil model with a delay
title_zh: 含时滞的曼昆-罗默-韦尔模型

abstract: We examine optimal strategy-proof voting mechanisms in environments where the designer lacks precise information about the probability distribution of individual utility profiles. This uncertainty over the true distribution is represented by a set of multiple distributions, and the designer evaluates mechanisms using either the worst-case utility sum or worst-case regret. Departing from the existing literature, we do not assume that utility functions are single-peaked or that the set of possible utility functions is maximally rich. In this setting, we show that the median voter rule is the unique optimal mechanism under both criteria. Our result provides a new justification for this well-known mechanism from a welfare perspective.
abstract_zh: 我们考察在设计师对个体效用分布概率缺乏精确信息的环境中的最优策略性投票机制。这种对真实分布的不确定性通过一组多重分布来表示，设计师依据最坏情况下的效用总和或最坏情况下的遗憾来评估机制。与现有文献不同，我们不假设效用函数是单峰的，也不假设可能的效用函数集合是最大丰富的。在此设定下，我们证明中位选民规则是这两种标准下的唯一最优机制。我们的结果为这一知名机制从福利角度提供了新的合理性依据。
title: Robustly Optimal Voting Rule

abstract: Cooperation is fundamental to the functioning of societies and has been extensively examined across economics, sociology, and biology. Traditional mechanisms for sustaining cooperation, such as punishment and exogenous rewards, often entail significant drawbacks, including resource wastage and dependence on external inputs. In response to these limitations, Yang et al. (2018) introduced an endogenous reward mechanism that maintains cooperation by imposing a tax on participants and allowing them to vote on the allocation of the collected tax revenue, thereby rewarding individuals with higher cooperative tendencies. This study aims to replicate and extend Yang et al. (2018)’s findings by employing a larger sample size and exploring the effects of varying tax rates on the sustainability of cooperation. Our results confirm that the endogenous reward mechanism effectively sustains cooperation, replicating Yang et al. (2018) conclusions at the 20% tax rate. Moreover, we discovered that the maintenance of cooperation follows an inverted U-shaped relationship with the tax rate, peaking at 60%. Higher and lower tax rates were found to be less effective in sustaining cooperative behavior. These findings provide valuable insights into optimizing tax rates for promoting cooperation.
abstract_zh: 合作是社会运作的基础，已在经济学、社会学和生物学领域得到广泛研究。传统的维持合作机制，如惩罚和外部奖励，往往伴随着显著缺陷，包括资源浪费和对外部投入的依赖。针对这些局限，Yang等人（2018）提出了一种内生奖励机制，通过对参与者征税并允许他们就税收收入的分配进行投票，从而奖励合作倾向较高的个体，以此维持合作。本研究旨在通过采用更大的样本量并探索不同税率对合作可持续性的影响，来复制并扩展Yang等人（2018）的研究发现。我们的结果证实，内生奖励机制能有效维持合作，在20%的税率下复制了Yang等人（2018）的结论。此外，我们发现合作的维持与税率呈倒U型关系，在60%时达到峰值。研究发现，较高和较低的税率在维持合作行为方面效果较差。这些发现为优化税率以促进合作提供了宝贵的见解。
title: Optimal tax rates in endogenous reward mechanisms: An inverted U-shaped impact on sustaining cooperation
title_zh: 内生奖励机制中的最优税率：对维持合作的倒U型影响

abstract: Deforestation and forest degradation within Brazilian Amazonia primarily occur on private lands, yet their extent varies considerably among properties. We combine high-resolution remote-sensing and land-ownership data to analyse relationships between property size and forest retention, canopy height, fragmentation and fire prevalence across 30,022 private properties within an > 113,000 km2 consolidated agricultural frontier. Bayesian geospatial regressions showed that larger properties retained a greater proportion of forest overall and within Riparian Protected Areas and were more likely to adhere to Legal Reserve requirements. Properties > 1000 ha contained 75.2% of all remaining forest, while ≤ 150 ha properties accounted for the largest shares of total deforestation (27.6%) and riparian losses (39.9%). Smaller properties were also associated with lower-stature forest canopy, higher forest fire densities, and greater landscape-scale (∼100-km2) fragmentation, primarily due to increased disaggregation of forest among, rather than within, landholdings. Smaller properties thus not only retained less forest, but this forest was more degraded, underscoring the need to tailor policy interventions within Brazilian Amazonia according to property size. Targeted subsidies and credit schemes could enable smallholders to farm a smaller portion of their land, restore forest and reduce reliance on degrading land-use practices (e.g., fires). Fines, embargoes, and stricter Forest Code enforcement may help preserve remaining forest and reduce fire use in largeholdings. Incentivising forest restoration across property boundaries, and offsetting forest cover deficits to remaining continuous forest tracts, would help minimise fragmentation. Implementing these measures will depend on collaboration between government agencies and NGOs to align enforcement, financing, and coordinate landscape-scale management.
abstract_zh: 巴西亚马孙地区的森林砍伐与退化主要发生在私有土地上，但其程度在不同地产间差异显著。我们结合高分辨率遥感与土地所有权数据，分析了超过113,000平方公里已整合农业前沿地带内30,022处私有地产的规模与森林保留、冠层高度、破碎化及火灾发生率之间的关系。贝叶斯地理空间回归显示，较大地产总体上保留了更高比例的森林，且在河岸保护区内的森林保留比例也更高，更可能遵守法定保护区要求。面积超过1000公顷的地产保留了全部剩余森林的75.2%，而面积不超过150公顷的地产则贡献了总森林砍伐量（27.6%）和河岸损失（39.9%）的最大份额。较小地产还与较低冠层高度的森林、较高的森林火灾密度以及更大尺度（约100平方公里）的景观破碎化相关，这主要归因于土地持有间而非土地内部的森林分散化加剧。因此，较小地产不仅保留的森林较少，且这些森林更为退化，凸显了在巴西亚马孙地区根据地产规模定制政策干预措施的必要性。定向补贴和信贷计划可使小农户仅耕作其土地的一小部分，恢复森林并减少对退化土地利用方式（如火灾）的依赖。罚款、禁运及更严格的《森林法》执行可能有助于保护大地产生存森林并减少火灾使用。激励跨地产边界的森林恢复，并将森林覆盖赤字抵消至剩余连续森林地块，将有助于最小化破碎化。实施这些措施将依赖于政府机构与非政府组织之间的合作，以协调执法、融资及景观尺度管理。
title: Property size linked to deforestation, fragmentation and forest fires in the Brazilian Amazon
title_zh: 巴西亚马逊地区财产规模与森林砍伐、破碎化及森林火灾的关联

abstract: Climate risk represents a systemic threat to global economic stability, forcing firms to fundamentally adapt. Drawing on risk-management and resource dependence theories, this study investigates how climate risk exposure (CRE) reshapes corporate green transformation (GT) using a panel of Chinese A-share non-financial firms (2016–2024). Our results indicate that elevated CRE acts as a disciplining force, significantly accelerating corporate GT. Mechanism analyses reveal that firms respond to this exposure strategically by advancing green technological innovation and improving environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance. Furthermore, this positive effect is amplified under specific boundary conditions: robust internal digital capabilities, accessible supply chain finance, and active monitoring by institutional investors. Heterogeneity analyses demonstrate that this proactive transition is more pronounced among state-owned enterprises, large corporations, and firms in regions with high public environmental awareness. By quantifying this behavioural response, this study suggests that external climate pressure catalyzes internal sustainable power, providing micro-level evidence for differentiated policy interventions.Footnote11 Abbreviations: green transformation (GT); climate risk exposure (CRE); World Meteorological Organization (WMO); Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC); Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD); Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS); Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG); China Research Data Services Platform (CNRDS); China Stock Market & Accounting Research (CSMAR); Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A); propensity score matching (PSM); two-stage least squares (2SLS); two-stage instrumental variables generalized method of moments (2SIV-GMM); difference-in-differences (DID); state-owned enterprises (SOEs); small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
abstract_zh: 气候风险对全球经济稳定构成系统性威胁，迫使企业进行根本性调整。本研究基于风险管理和资源依赖理论，利用2016至2024年中国A股非金融企业面板数据，探讨气候风险暴露（CRE）如何重塑企业绿色转型（GT）。研究结果表明，气候风险暴露的升高作为一种约束力量，显著加速了企业的绿色转型。机制分析显示，企业通过推进绿色技术创新和改善环境、社会及治理（ESG）表现来战略性地应对这种暴露。此外，这一积极效应在特定边界条件下得到增强：强大的内部数字化能力、可获得的供应链金融以及机构投资者的积极监督。异质性分析表明，这种主动转型在国有企业、大型企业以及公众环保意识较高地区的企业中更为显著。通过量化这一行为反应，本研究提出外部气候压力能够催化内部可持续发展动力，为差异化政策干预提供了微观层面的证据。脚注1 缩写：绿色转型（GT）；气候风险暴露（CRE）；世界气象组织（WMO）；政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）；气候相关财务信息披露工作组（TCFD）；央行与监管机构绿色金融网络（NGFS）；环境、社会与治理（ESG）；中国研究数据服务平台（CNRDS）；中国股票市场与会计研究数据库（CSMAR）；管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）；倾向得分匹配（PSM）；两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）；两阶段工具变量广义矩估计（2SIV-GMM）；双重差分法（DID）；国有企业（SOEs）；中小企业（SMEs）。

title: Turning pressure into power: climate risk exposure and corporate green transformation

abstract: Deforestation poses significant ecological, economic, and social challenges globally. The magnitude of deforestation is, however, spatially heterogeneous, arguable to be higher in the productive agro-ecological landscapes such as in ecological corridors. Agroforestry systems and specifically Silvo-arable, offer a promising solution by balancing agricultural productivity with conservation goals. Their adoption, however, remains restrained due to limited awareness on economic viability and perceived risks among farmers. This study assessed the land use land cover changes of Baga Kisimagonja ecological corridor (BKG) in Tanzania between 1992 and 2022. The study further employs a probabilistic cost-benefit analysis (PCBA) to assess the economic viability of traditional agroforestry practices in comparison to conventional crop farming. The findings indicate that over the study period, crop land expanded at an annual rate of about three to six percent while agroforestry grew at a rate of less than three percent. Forest land decreased by an average of two percent per annum. Such land use dynamics is associated to a net carbon loss of 2.3–3.5 kt C year−1, valued at approximately 18771–32681 USD year−1. Additionally, our analysis showed that agroforestry systems are economically viable compared to conventional crop farming and more so when carbon benefits are integrated. We conclude that agroforestry has the potential to mitigate deforestation and enhance long-term land-use resilience if implemented effectively. The findings of this study are important to guide policymakers, farmers, and conservation organizations in making informed investments in agroforestry technologies and practices to restore the degraded ecosystems.
abstract_zh: 森林砍伐在全球范围内带来了严峻的生态、经济和社会挑战。然而，森林砍伐的程度在空间上存在异质性，在生产力较高的农业生态景观中，如生态廊道，其程度可能更为严重。农林复合系统，特别是林农复合经营模式，通过平衡农业生产与保护目标，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，由于农民对经济可行性的认识有限及感知风险的存在，其采用仍受到制约。本研究评估了1992年至2022年间坦桑尼亚巴加基斯马贡贾生态廊道（BKG）的土地利用/土地覆盖变化。研究进一步采用概率成本效益分析（PCBA），评估传统农林复合实践相较于传统作物种植的经济可行性。研究结果表明，在研究期间，耕地面积以每年约3%至6%的速度扩张，而农林复合面积增长率低于3%。森林面积年均减少约2%。这种土地利用动态与每年2.3至3.5千吨碳的净碳损失相关，其价值约为每年18771至32681美元。此外，我们的分析显示，农林复合系统在经济上比传统作物种植更具可行性，且在纳入碳效益后尤为显著。我们得出结论，若有效实施，农林复合具有减缓森林砍伐和增强长期土地利用韧性的潜力。本研究的发现对于指导政策制定者、农民和保护组织在农林复合技术和实践方面做出明智投资，以恢复退化生态系统具有重要意义。
title: Analyzing the economics of agroforestry within land use and land cover change: The case of the Baga-Kisimagonja ecological corridor of Tanzania
title_zh: 农林业在土地利用与土地覆盖变化中的经济学分析：坦桑尼亚巴加-基西马贡贾生态廊道案例研究

abstract: This paper examines the causal impact of cannabidiol (CBD) product availability on workplace injuries, exploiting Italy’s unintended liberalization of low-THC cannabis as a natural experiment. We use a staggered difference-in-differences approach, leveraging variation in the timing of CBD retailer entries across provinces. We find that CBD availability leads to a reduction in workplace injury rates by 2.5%, with larger effects among young and prime-age workers. Robustness checks confirm these findings, and placebo tests rule out confounding trends. These effects are stronger in provinces with higher pre-existing use of pharmaceuticals commonly prescribed for stress, anxiety, sleep disorders, and chronic therapies. We interpret this pattern as suggestive of a substitution-based channel in which CBD products may represent an additional source of pain and stress management.
abstract_zh: 本文利用意大利低THC大麻意外合法化作为自然实验，考察大麻二酚（CBD）产品可及性对工伤的因果影响。我们采用交错双重差分法，利用各省CBD零售商进入时间的差异。研究发现，CBD可及性使工伤率降低2.5%，其中对青年和壮年劳动者的影响更为显著。稳健性检验证实了上述结论，安慰剂检验排除了混杂趋势的影响。在那些此前常用于缓解压力、焦虑、睡眠障碍及慢性治疗的药物使用率较高的省份，这种效应更为突出。我们将这一模式解读为替代效应渠道的佐证，即CBD产品可能成为疼痛与压力管理的额外来源。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: CBD at work: the impact of cannabidiol access on workplace health
title_zh: 工作中的CBD：大麻二酚获取对职场健康的影响

abstract: We examine inference in a two-group, three-period staggered difference-in-differences setting where conventional pre-trends testing is infeasible. By imposing structured assumptions on treatment effect heterogeneity and dynamics, we develop a novel framework that enables reliable inference on the direction of treatment effects while relaxing the parallel-trends assumption. We apply this framework to assess the effects of minimum wages in China, a context in which the validity of existing DiD-based findings may be compromised by the inability to validate pre-trends. The results indicate that minimum wages substantially increase the wages of low-skilled rural migrant workers, with no detectable effects for high-skilled workers. We find no evidence of employment reductions; conversely, the findings suggest a positive employment effect for low-skilled workers.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了一个两组、三期交错双重差分设定中的推断问题，在该设定下，传统的预趋势检验不可行。通过对处理效应异质性和动态性施加结构化假设，我们开发了一个新框架，该框架能够在放宽平行趋势假设的同时，实现对处理效应方向的可靠推断。我们将此框架应用于评估中国最低工资的影响，在这一背景下，现有基于双重差分的研究发现的有效性可能因无法验证预趋势而受到损害。结果表明，最低工资显著提高了低技能农村流动工人的工资，而对高技能工人则未检测到显著效应。我们未发现就业减少的证据；相反，研究结果提示最低工资对低技能工人存在正向就业效应。

title: Two-group, three-period staggered difference-in-differences design and evaluation of labour market effects of minimum wages in China
title_zh: 两组三阶段交错双重差分设计与中国最低工资劳动力市场效应评估

abstract: Mitigating transboundary pollution requires internalizing environmental externalities and coordinating inter-jurisdictional interests. This paper examines the environmental and economic consequences of China's watershed ecological compensation (WEC) policy, a government-led property rights allocation scheme that combines Coasean bargaining with state-contingent contracts. By exploiting the progressive roll-out of inter-provincial WEC schemes and employing a difference-in-difference-in-differences design with a novel county-level dataset containing long-term industrial water pollutant information, we find that upstream counties experience significant reductions in pollution emissions but slower economic growth relative to their adjacent downstream counties after policy implementation. Event study estimates further indicate that environmental governance entailing high economic costs is difficult to sustain over time, reflecting a potential misalignment between costs and benefits in environmental protection. These effects can be attributed to pollution-control-oriented policy measures adopted by upstream local governments and the resulting responses of firms and residents. We further show that upstream local governments' prioritization of environmental governance is shaped by both economic and political incentives. Our findings offer insights into institutional design for improving transboundary water quality in countries with decentralized environmental management systems.
abstract_zh: 缓解跨界污染需要将环境外部性内部化并协调跨辖区利益。本文研究了中国流域生态补偿（WEC）政策的环境与经济后果，该政策是一种政府主导的产权分配机制，结合了科斯式谈判与状态依赖契约。利用省际流域生态补偿方案的逐步推广，并采用包含长期工业水污染物信息的新型县级数据集进行三重差分设计，我们发现，与相邻下游县相比，政策实施后上游县的污染排放显著减少，但经济增长速度相对放缓。事件研究估计进一步表明，涉及高经济成本的环境治理难以长期维持，反映出环境保护中成本与收益之间可能存在的错配。这些效应可归因于上游地方政府采取的以污染控制为导向的政策措施以及企业和居民的相应反应。我们进一步表明，上游地方政府对环境治理的优先排序受到经济和政治激励的双重影响。我们的研究为在环境管理分散化国家中改善跨界水质的制度设计提供了启示。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Evaluating the environmental and economic implications of curbing transboundary pollution: Evidence from China
title_zh: 遏制跨界污染的环境与经济影响评估：来自中国的证据

abstract: We study the structure of random ordinal Bayesian incentive compatible (OBIC) rules. We restrict attention to some special class of priors that we call “uniform-like” priors. We consider a class of priors, called top uniform priors: for any two alternatives a and b, a prior is top uniform if the aggregate probability (under the prior distribution) of preferences with respectively a and b at the top are the same. Over the unrestricted domain the uniform prior is a member of this class. We consider a class of random voting rules—random vote share rules, a generalization of plurality rule. For top uniform priors and arbitrary domains, Theorem 4.1 shows that every top monotonic and symmetric random vote share rule is OBIC. Over a domain satisfying some natural “richness” condition, we demonstrate that if a symmetric and strongly top responsive random vote share rule is OBIC with respect to some prior, then that prior must necessarily be a top uniform prior. We also provide some analogous results for veto share rules that are probabilistic generalizations of anti-plurality rule.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了随机序数贝叶斯激励相容（OBIC）规则的结构。我们关注一类特殊的先验分布，称之为“类均匀”先验。我们考虑一类称为顶部均匀先验的先验：对于任意两个备选方案a和b，若在先验分布下，分别以a和b为顶部的偏好总概率相同，则该先验为顶部均匀先验。在无限制域上，均匀先验属于此类。我们考虑一类随机投票规则——随机投票份额规则，这是多数规则的推广。对于顶部均匀先验和任意域，定理4.1表明，每个顶部单调且对称的随机投票份额规则都是OBIC的。在满足某些自然“丰富性”条件的域上，我们证明，若一个对称且强顶部响应的随机投票份额规则相对于某个先验是OBIC的，则该先验必然为顶部均匀先验。我们还为否决份额规则提供了类似的结果，这些规则是反多数规则的概率推广。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: On the ordinal Bayesian incentive compatibility of vote share and veto share rules
title_zh: 关于投票份额与否决份额规则的序数贝叶斯激励相容性

abstract: The smooth ambiguity model (Klibanoff et al., 2005) or second-order subjective expected utility (SOSEU) model (Nau, 2006; Seo, 2009; Giraud, 2014) has two characteristics that contribute to its success: it is an iterated expected utility and, under certain conditions, it is smooth. These characteristics allow for the use of standard analytical techniques from expected utility theory, including optimization calculus. In this paper, we utilize the continuous differentiability ( C 1 ) of the SOSEU functional to offer an axiomatic characterization of this model. First, we define C 1 preferences and provide a representation for them. Then, assuming that preferences are C 1 , the primary axiom that delivers the iterated expected utility form essentially states that if decision makers are more sensitive to perturbations of one portfolio of assets than another one when the probability distribution is known, then they are still more sensitive when it is not.
abstract_zh: 平滑模糊模型（Klibanoff等，2005）或二阶主观期望效用（SOSEU）模型（Nau，2006；Seo，2009；Giraud，2014）具有两个促使其成功的特征：它是一个迭代期望效用，并且在特定条件下是平滑的。这些特征使得能够运用期望效用理论中的标准分析技术，包括优化微积分。本文利用SOSEU泛函的连续可微性（C¹），为该模型提供了一种公理化刻画。首先，我们定义了C¹偏好并为其提供了表示。然后，假设偏好是C¹的，实现迭代期望效用形式的主要公理实质上表明：如果在概率分布已知的情况下，决策者对某一资产组合的扰动比另一资产组合更为敏感，那么在概率分布未知时，他们依然会更为敏感。
title: An axiomatization of the smooth ambiguity model using differentiability
title_zh: 使用可微性对平滑模糊模型进行公理化

abstract: This paper studies competition under information heterogeneity in selection markets and examines the impact of public information regulations aimed at reducing information asymmetries between competing firms. We develop a novel model and introduce new empirical strategies to analyze imperfect competition in markets where firms have heterogeneous information about consumers, vary in cost structures, and offer differentiated products. Using data from the Italian auto insurance market, we find substantial differences in the precision of risk ratings across insurers, and those with less accurate risk-rating algorithms tend to have more efficient cost structures. We assess the equilibrium effects of giving firms equal access to aggregated risk information from a centralized bureau. This policy significantly reduces prices by increasing competition, leading to a 15.7% boost in consumer surplus, almost reaching the efficiency benchmark where firms have full knowledge of consumers’ true risk. Aggregating information through the bureau favors low-risk consumers and reduces average costs by 12 euros per contract through more efficient insurer-insuree matching.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在选择性市场中信息异质性下的竞争问题，并探讨了旨在减少竞争企业间信息不对称的公共信息监管政策的影响。我们构建了一个新颖的模型，并引入了新的实证策略，以分析企业在消费者信息掌握程度、成本结构差异及产品差异化方面存在异质性的不完全竞争市场。利用意大利汽车保险市场的数据，我们发现不同保险公司的风险评级精度存在显著差异，而风险评级算法精度较低的公司往往拥有更高效的成本结构。我们评估了赋予企业平等获取中央机构汇总风险信息这一政策的均衡效应。该政策通过增强竞争显著降低了价格，使消费者剩余提升15.7%，几乎达到企业完全掌握消费者真实风险时的效率基准。通过中央机构汇总信息有利于低风险消费者，并通过更高效的保险公司与投保人匹配，使每份合同平均成本降低12欧元。
title: Competing under Information Heterogeneity: Evidence from Auto Insurance
title_zh: 信息异质性下的竞争：来自汽车保险的证据

abstract: This paper examines the effects of a shock to angel finance on entrepreneurial activity. Using U.S. Census data, we estimate the state-level fraction of households that lost accreditation status from Dodd–Frank’s elimination of housing wealth in determining accreditation. A larger reduction in the pool of potential investors reduces angel investment, firm entry, and employment at small entrants. Employment increases at small and young incumbents, suggesting competitive effects. Though we document partial substitution, angel finance appears to complement other capital sources in the entrepreneurial ecosystem. Our paper offers insight on the impact of angel finance and where it matters most.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了天使融资冲击对创业活动的影响。利用美国人口普查数据，我们估算了因多德-弗兰克法案取消住房财富在认定合格投资者资格中的作用，而导致各州失去合格投资者身份的家庭比例。潜在投资者池的更大缩减减少了天使投资、企业进入以及小型新进入企业的就业。小型和年轻在位企业的就业增加，表明存在竞争效应。尽管我们记录了部分替代效应，但天使融资似乎与创业生态系统中的其他资本来源形成互补。本文为理解天使融资的影响及其最关键的作用领域提供了洞见。
title: Angels, entrepreneurship, and employment dynamics: Evidence from investor accreditation rules
title_zh: 天使投资、创业与就业动态：来自投资者认证规则的证据

abstract: This paper analyzes the effect of coups d’état on the size of the informal economy in a large sample of 98 developing countries observed over the period 1993–2020. Using a matched difference-in-differences approach that combines a two-way fixed effects model with entropy balancing, we find that the occurrence of a coup d’état significantly increases the size of the informal economy. This result is robust across a variety of tests, including event-study analysis, propensity score matching, treatment effect methods based on inverse probability weighting, generalized method of moments estimation, fixed-effects regressions, a falsification test, checks for potential omitted variables, alternative data sources for coups d’état, the exclusion of nonmilitary coups, and accounting for coup d’état spillover effects. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the detrimental effect of coups d’état holds for both successful and failed coups and is influenced by structural factors. Specifically, the effect decreases with higher levels of domestic credit to the private sector, remittances, quality of regulation, and net official development assistance received. Conversely, the effect increases with higher real GDP per capita, democracy, unemployment, oil rents, and income inequality. Higher external debt, lower gross fixed capital formation, and erosion of democracy are the main channels through which coups d’état expand the informal economy in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了1993年至2020年间98个发展中国家中政变对非正规经济规模的影响。采用结合双向固定效应模型与熵平衡的匹配双重差分方法，我们发现政变的发生显著扩大了非正规经济的规模。这一结果在多种检验中均保持稳健，包括事件研究分析、倾向得分匹配、基于逆概率加权的处理效应方法、广义矩估计、固定效应回归、证伪检验、潜在遗漏变量检查、政变数据的替代来源、排除非军事政变以及考虑政变溢出效应等。异质性分析表明，政变的不利影响在成功与失败的政变中均存在，并受结构性因素影响。具体而言，随着国内私人部门信贷、汇款、监管质量及收到的官方发展援助净额的提高，该效应减弱；反之，随着实际人均GDP、民主程度、失业率、石油租金及收入不平等的增加，该效应增强。外部债务上升、固定资本形成总额下降及民主侵蚀是政变扩大发展中国家非正规经济的主要渠道。
title: Coups d’état and the informal economy

abstract: We examine how social observability affects the willingness of low-income individuals to apply for financial support. After completing tasks to earn income in the lab, participants are given the opportunity to apply for a transfer from a social fund earmarked for the lowest earners. We experimentally vary whether the application is public or private and whether the funds come from the experimenters or other participants. We find that making the application public reduces take-up by 31 percentage points. Adding peer funding leads to a further 10 percentage point drop. These effects are strongest when income is earned through effort instead of a lottery, and when both public visibility and peer funding are present. The findings are not driven by altruistic or redistributive preferences, but perspective taking makes participants more sensitive to the public application treatment. Our findings suggest that ensuring privacy in the application process helps increase access to income support programs.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了社会可见性如何影响低收入个体申请经济支持的意愿。在实验室中完成赚取收入的任务后，参与者有机会申请从一项专为最低收入者设立的社会基金中获得转移支付。我们通过实验变化申请是公开还是私密，以及资金来源是实验者还是其他参与者。我们发现，将申请公开化会使参与率下降31个百分点。增加同伴资助则导致进一步下降10个百分点。这些效应在收入通过努力而非抽签获得时最为显著，并且当公开可见性与同伴资助同时存在时效果最强。这些发现并非由利他或再分配偏好驱动，但换位思考使参与者对公开申请处理更为敏感。我们的结果表明，确保申请过程中的隐私有助于增加收入支持项目的可及性。
title: Social observability and demand for transfers: Experimental evidence from a low income population
title_zh: 社会可见性与转移支付需求：来自低收入群体的实验证据
